name: Hans-Dieter Schwarz
bio:
Hans-Dieter's obsession with motorsport began during his childhood, watching DTM races with his grandfather. He quickly became fascinated by the intricate liveries and the vibrant colors adorning the racing cars. This passion led him to pursue a vocational training program specializing in automotive painting and refinishing. After graduating with honors, Hans-Dieter sought opportunities within the motorsport industry, eventually landing a role at Lechner Racing.

At Lechner Racing, Hans-Dieter is responsible for preparing and applying the paint schemes to the team's race cars. He approaches his work with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring that every surface is flawless and that the colors are precisely matched to the team's specifications. His dedication and precision have earned him a reputation as a reliable and skilled paint shop specialist.

What sets Hans-Dieter apart is his ability to blend traditional techniques with modern technologies. He is always experimenting with new materials and processes to enhance the durability and aesthetics of the paint finishes. His unwavering commitment to quality and his passion for motorsport make him a valuable asset to the Lechner Racing team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed to the side with a slight wave.
physical.description: Hans-Dieter is of average height with a lean build, often seen wearing protective eyewear and a work apron.

quirks: Always meticulously cleans his spray gun immediately after use.
Insists on using a specific brand of masking tape, believing it provides the cleanest lines.
Listens to classical music while working to maintain focus and precision.
